name: Tech Mahindra
verdict: A listed associate of Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd; Life Insurance Corporation of India, owned by the Government of India, holds 11.49% of its shares. On hold for a maintainer.
note: Rating note: on hold for a maintainer, changed from none during review of PR #1227. Mahindra & Mahindra's Integrated Annual Report 2025-26 describes Tech Mahindra Limited as a 'listed Associate of the Company' (promoter group holds 34.98% per the Q3 FY26 pattern). Tech Mahindra's shareholding pattern for the quarter ended 31 December 2025 shows Life Insurance Corporation Of India holding 112,606,132 shares (11.49%); LIC's promoter is the President of India (96.50%). The data has no record claim for India, and whether a state-owned Indian insurer's stake above 5% counts for a rating (i.e. whether India is treated as a state with a record of serious abuses) is a maintainer decision. No human-rights finding against the company itself was identified. Tech Mahindra is the team's Digital Transformation Partner per Mahindra Racing's official partners page.
